ui.repeat_or_help: Press 1 to repeat, 2 to get the steps by SMS, 9 to talk to an extension officer.
ui.connecting: Connecting you to an extension officer.
ui.no_officer: No officer is available right now. Please call your local extension office.
ui.help_line: Dial *384*4074# any time to check again.
ui.no_input: We did not get your answer. Please call again.

ui.retake_dark: Photo is too dark. Move to better light.
ui.retake_bright: Photo is too bright. Shade the leaf and retake.
ui.retake_no_leaf: No leaf found. Fill the photo with one leaf.
ui.retake_too_quiet: Move the phone closer to the machine.
ui.retake_no_machine: Machine not detected. Is it running?

questions.q_leaves_twisted: Are the leaves twisted, curled or misshapen?
questions.q_yellow_green_patches: Do the leaves have mixed yellow and green patches?
questions.q_yellow_along_veins: Are there yellow patches along the veins of older, lower leaves?
questions.q_brown_streak_or_root_rot: Are there brown streaks on green stems, or brown rot inside the roots?
questions.q_wet_spots_or_wilting: Are there wet-looking angular spots, or wilting and dying shoot tips?
questions.q_tiny_yellow_dots: Are leaves pale with tiny yellow dots, and top leaves small and bunched?
questions.q_ragged_holes_frass: Are there ragged holes in leaves and sawdust-like droppings in the centre?
questions.q_powdery_rust_spots: Are there small reddish-brown powdery spots that rub off on your finger?
questions.q_long_grey_lesions: Are there long grey or tan patches, shaped like a cigar?
questions.q_broken_yellow_streaks: Are there thin broken yellow or white streaks along the leaf veins?
questions.q_sudden_wilt_green: Does the whole plant wilt quickly while its leaves are still green?
questions.q_small_curled_yellow_edges: Are the leaves small, curled upward, with yellow edges?
questions.q_leaf_mines_fruit_holes: Are there pale winding tunnels inside leaves, or small holes in fruits?
questions.q_dark_wet_patches_spread: Are there large dark wet-looking patches that spread fast after rain?
questions.q_target_ring_spots: Are there brown spots with rings, like a target, on lower leaves?

tomato_other_leaf_problem.name: Possible tomato leaf disease, type unclear

remove_infected_plants.text: Pull out and destroy infected plants.

use_clean_cuttings.text: Plant only cuttings from healthy plants.

plant_tolerant_variety.text: Ask for a tolerant variety for next season.

do_not_share_cuttings.text: Do not give or take cuttings from this field.

harvest_early_check_roots.text: Check roots and harvest early if they are affected.

check_underside_leaves.text: Check under the leaves for tiny mites.

ask_extension_officer.text: Show the plant to an extension officer.

rescan_if_sound_changes.text: Scan again if the sound changes.

stop_machine.text: Stop the machine if it is safe to do so.

check_mounting_bolts.text: Check that mounting bolts are tight.

check_belts_and_bearings.text: Check belts and bearings for wear.

contact_mechanic.text: Call a mechanic before running it for long.

check_whorls_morning.text: Check the centre of young plants early in the morning.

crush_eggs_and_larvae.text: Crush egg masses and caterpillars by hand.

ask_officer_approved_control.text: Ask an extension officer about approved control. Follow the label.

remove_crop_residue.text: Remove or bury old plant remains after harvest.

rotate_crops.text: Do not plant the same crop in this spot next season.

plant_with_neighbours.text: Plant at the same time as nearby farms next season.

control_weeds.text: Keep grass weeds down around the field.

remove_wilted_with_soil.text: Pull out wilted plants with the soil around the roots and destroy them.

no_solanaceae_next_season.text: Do not plant tomato, pepper or eggplant here next season.

destroy_infested_leaves_fruit.text: Pick and destroy damaged leaves and fruits.

use_pheromone_traps.text: Ask about pheromone traps for this pest.

water_soil_not_leaves.text: Water the soil, not the leaves.

space_plants.text: Give plants more space so air can move.

mulch_soil.text: Cover the soil with mulch to stop splashing.

plant_resistant_variety.text: Plant a resistant variety next season.

keep_checking_weekly.text: Keep checking your plants every week.
